note: Two serving checkpoints of Kimi K3.1-Pro. Model every topology under both; they may serve different parts of the pareto. KV/state precision is the same for both (FP8 MLA KV, MXFP4 indexer KV in our serving rules; the NVFP4 model card evaluates with FP8 KV/indexer and FP32 SSM state). Sources: release config.json (d9e99b07) quantization_config; https://huggingface.co/nvidia/Kimi-K3.1-Pro-NVFP4 config.json quantization_config (modelopt_mixed) + README 'Post Training Quantization', fetched 2026-11-17.

routed_experts.gemm_peak: mxfp8 x mxfp4 -> use the MXFP8 tensor rate unless a W4A8 kernel runs at FP4 rate

routed_experts.weights: NVFP4 (group 16, FP8 E4M3 scales + global scale)

mla_dsa_projections.note: MLA layers kept in BF16 for accuracy recovery (README)

nvfp4_modelopt.accuracy: README: GPQA-D 93.84 vs 93.97 (MXFP4), AA-LCR 82.06 vs 81.69, IFBench 73.40 vs 73.40, MMMU-Pro 81.79 vs 81.68, SciCode 59.47 vs 59.52, TB2.1 87.78 vs 88.20

precision_rule_note: User rule 'no numerical loss' is defined relative to the chosen checkpoint: serve each checkpoint at its own stored precisions (no extra quantization beyond it); FP8 MLA KV, FP4 indexer KV, FP32 KDA state for both.
